title: 轉發許可流量計量正確性與排除項 (Forward-Admission Traffic Metering & Exclusions)
expected: Admitted member forwarding traffic across fvmb0 <-> fvup0 is metered within ±1% under forward_admission_v1; WireGuard handshakes, blocked RFC1918/ULA packets, and node-local DNS queries to :53 are excluded from member usage counters, and fvpn-agent uploads the sampled kernel counters to the central ledger.
